title: Hanotsume Beading Tray
description:
Personally, I don't really like beading mats because the needle gets stuck when picking up beads. I also avoid those little triangle trays since they flip over easily if bumped. So, this model is my take on the ideal beading tray.

In addition to the main tray, there is also a matching lid, which doubles as a second tray when removed. Note that it's slightly wider and taller.

Print Tip: Set the Top surface angle to 0° or 180° so the extrusion lines run parallel to the long edge of the tray. This makes picking up beads super satisfying, as the needle tip glides smoothly right along the grooves!
